# scarlet-heading



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A semantic heading (`<h1>`–`<h6>`) with an independently controllable
visual size — document structure (`level`) and visual hierarchy
(`variant`) don't have to match one-to-one.

## Properties

| Property  | Attribute | Description                                                        | Type                                                                                                                                                         | Default     |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `align`   | `align`   | Text alignment.                                                    | `"center" \| "left" \| "right"`                                                                                                                              | `'left'`    |
| `color`   | `color`   | Text color token.                                                  | `"disabled" \| "inverse" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary"`                                                                                          | `'primary'` |
| `level`   | `level`   | Semantic heading level — which HTML tag (`h1`–`h6`) is rendered.   | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6`                                                                                                                                 | `2`         |
| `variant` | `variant` | Visual size. Defaults to a sensible size for `level` when omitted. | `"display-2xl" \| "display-lg" \| "display-md" \| "display-sm" \| "display-xl" \| "heading-lg" \| "heading-md" \| "heading-sm" \| "heading-xl" \| undefined` | `undefined` |
